## Hypothesis

The 1-2 DTE weekly options setting captures edge across VIX regimes, with potentially higher expectancy in elevated VIX (>20) due to richer premium, while maintaining positive expectancy in low VIX (<15) due to directional edge. Stratifying by VIX allows us to isolate regime-dependent performance and avoid overfitting to a single volatility environment.

## Mechanism

Entry uses the same directional signal as the base WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate (ITM-2 put/call based on bearish/bullish setup) at 1-2 days to expiration. Exit uses fixed -8%/+30% premium targets. The position is sized according to risk rules (max 50% of equity per trade). VIX stratification is applied post-hoc for analysis; no filter is applied in the engine.
